versions.content: The Dem shall provide functionality during runtime to treat events as if they were not configured as DemEventParameter . The configuration parameter DemAvailabilitySupport is used to enable the functionality provided by Dem_- SetEventAvailable ().

The Dem shall provide the functionality to treat events as if they were not configured as DemEventParameter . The configuration parameter DemAvailabilitySupport is used to enable the functionality (including API Dem_- SetEventAvailable ).
